summary.headline: Top frustrations with standing desks: owners stop standing at them, standing all day hurts their feet and legs, and motors or legs fail and get the desk stuck.
summary.text: Of 64 genuine posts (from 263 pulled), the two biggest themes are behavioral, not hardware: 15 owners say the desk became 'an expensive shelf' and 15 describe foot, leg or back pain from standing. Another 12 report desks stuck up or down or a leg motor dying, and wobble with monitors and walking pads keeps coming up, so a new entrant could compete on reliability plus built-in habit nudges.

rubric.formula: score = 10 x (0.40 x frequency + 0.35 x intensity + 0.25 x fixability)
